method.camera: Unchanged normal cottage-deck gameplay camera during all timing conditions; no player or camera inputs
method.metric: Median of five GPU reporting-window means, not pooled per-frame median
method.externalLoad: Another deployed portfolio tab remained open; external load and GPU clocks uncontrolled
method.interruption: One browser request timed out before the final on transition. A fresh DOM snapshot still showed culling off, with only four conditions recorded. The on transition was performed successfully and A3 was captured after a new Restart readings; no timed-out sample is included.

summary.supportedConclusion: About 2.05–2.61 ms (9.5–11.8%) lower GPU render time with culling on in this one fixed view; no consistent FPS gain established
summary.visualLimit: No obvious missing surface or shading discrepancy in the inspected gameplay and wide debug views. Animated frames with overlays are not pixel equality or all-angle/near-collision coverage. House/workshop/book traversal was not repeated.
